fields.prompt: What are you building? Describe the product and what it must do, in plain words.
Which project type fits best — for example a consumer sensor device, a motor controller, or firmware for an existing board?
What stage is the project at — idea, sketch, prototype, existing product, or production?
What constraints matter most — size, power, environment, cost, or parts you have already chosen?
What is your budget posture — a range you want to stay inside, or a target you want us to test?
When must this exist, and what drives that date?
Where will this be sold or used, and do any approvals or handling rules apply (for example FCC/CE, or controlled information)?
